svg.aria-label: How the J of diamonds played out in room ADKY. Live: six tricks, the banker team (bots 1 and 3) won five of them; the attackers finished on 35 points, so the banker team went up 2 levels. Double-dummy with all cards visible and everyone playing perfectly: leading the J of diamonds ends with attackers on 35 (banker team +2 levels); leading the ace of clubs ends with attackers on 45 (+1 level). The bot chose from 64 sampled worlds; on this real deal the exact answer agrees.
svg.text: ADKY round 1, from the lead at 7 cards each. Seat 0 is the human; seats 1, 2, 3 are bots; 1 and 3 are the banker team.
DOUBLE-DUMMY: everyone plays perfectly with all cards visible; the human did not
J♦ is worth one more level on this deal; the bot chose it from 64 sampled worlds (J♦ 1.797 vs A♣ 1.719).
One real deal can disagree with the sampled mean; this one did not.
Solver: endgame_compact.CompactWorldSession (alpha-beta, exact points), run on the true hands rebuilt from the ADKY log.
